import unittest

from solution import compare_radix_literals


class CompareRadixLiteralsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_input(self):
        self.assertEqual(compare_radix_literals([]), [])
        self.assertEqual(compare_radix_literals(iter(())), [])

    def test_sorts_by_exact_numeric_value_not_literal_text(self):
        items = [
            ("ten", "10", 10),
            ("two", "10", 2),
            ("negative", "-F", 16),
            ("large", "100", 36),
            ("zero", "0", 2),
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            compare_radix_literals(items),
            ["negative", "zero", "two", "ten", "large"],
        )

    def test_signs_case_insensitivity_and_all_base_36_digits(self):
        items = [
            ("positive", "+a", 16),
            ("negative", "-Z", 36),
            ("upper", "A", 16),
            ("base36", "z", 36),
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            compare_radix_literals(items),
            ["negative", "positive", "upper", "base36"],
        )

    def test_equal_values_retain_input_order_and_duplicate_labels(self):
        items = [
            ("same", "10", 10),
            ("binary", "1010", 2),
            ("same", "+A", 16),
            ("leading-zero", "00010", 10),
            ("negative-zero", "-0", 2),
            ("positive-zero", "+0", 36),
        ]
        self.assertEqual(compare_radix_literals(items), [
            "negative-zero", "positive-zero", "same", "binary", "same", "leading-zero",
        ])

    def test_generator_input_is_consumed_in_order(self):
        source = [("three", "11", 2), ("one", "1", 10), ("two", "2", 10)]
        self.assertEqual(
            compare_radix_literals((item for item in source)),
            ["one", "two", "three"],
        )

    def test_input_and_elements_are_not_mutated(self):
        items = [["ten", "A", 16], ["one", "1", 10]]
        snapshot = [item[:] for item in items]
        result = compare_radix_literals(items)
        self.assertEqual(result, ["one", "ten"])
        self.assertEqual(items, snapshot)

    def test_malformed_triples_labels_and_literals_raise_value_error(self):
        invalid_inputs = [
            [("label", "1")],
            [("label", "1", 10, "extra")],
            ["abc"],
            [(1, "1", 10)],
            [(None, "1", 10)],
            [("label", "", 10)],
            [("label", "+", 10)],
            [("label", "-", 10)],
            [("label", "2", 2)],
            [("label", "G", 16)],
            [("label", "1_0", 10)],
            [("label", " 1", 10)],
        ]
        for items in invalid_inputs:
            with self.subTest(items=items):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    compare_radix_literals(items)

    def test_invalid_base_types_raise_type_error(self):
        for base in (True, False, 10.0, "10", None):
            with self.subTest(base=base):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    compare_radix_literals([("label", "1", base)])

    def test_out_of_range_bases_raise_value_error(self):
        for base in (1, 0, -2, 37, 100):
            with self.subTest(base=base):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    compare_radix_literals([("label", "1", base)])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
